about: POST /installs, 200: a replay of an install_id publik API already knows, with key null (docs/PUBLIK-CONTRACT.md §5): keep the key on disk, or mint once more under a fresh install_id when there is none. Tests set install_id to the one they sent. Every value is invented.

body.cost_sentence: A typical rewrite costs less than one cent, paid from this computer's publik balance.
